item.title: Artemis II astronauts splash down on Earth after record-breaking lunar flyby
item.summary: NASA celebrated late Friday as four astronauts splashed down safely off the California coast, completing the first crewed lunar flyby in more than 50 years and marking a major milestone for the US space agency’s ambitions to return humans to the moon.
